note: Park on US 54 at La Harpe, east of Iola, in two sections (west entrance at 403 US 54, east off Broadway). Rates by phone only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed and upgraded from note prose to the operator's About page: 31 sites, 18 pull-through, full hookups, 30/50 A, WiFi. Still no posted rate ('call for rates'). RV Life $$ is the only price indicator. Google 4.1 over 65.
flags: PRICE: no posted rate on the operator's site ('call us at 620-496-8888' for rates). The price indicator is RV Life $$ (stored rating.price_tier 2), so it passes on tier only. No dated 2024+ rate was found, and there's no gateway within 40 km.

Presence: website https://www.jayhawkerrvpark.com/ plus phone 620-496-8888, and Google 4.1 over 65 (at least 4.0, so it stays). The website is dated (blog 'New Website 4/18/2014' is the only post) but live.

Long-stay tests, a borderline lean: (1) nightly stays are sold ('Daily, weekly and monthly rates available'; check-out 11 a.m.); (2) no age rule seen; (3) the rules page is written for residents: mail via a La Harpe P.O. box, deliveries held at the office, proof of liability insurance on request, 'lessee' throughout; (4) no stated share of seasonal sites; (5) no rig-age rule. That reads as a park with a sizable monthly population, but it still takes overnighters. Kept, with that noted for AWH. Reviews could decide it, but I didn't read them.
Not a split: the two sections (west from US 54 at 403, east from Broadway) are ~150 m apart in one park.
Not waterfront: confirmed. The pin is on the east gravel area, about 15 m from Google's, which is fine.
The address differs: the website gives 403 US Highway 54 (park entrance), while the contact page and Google give 112 S. Broadway (owners' office). It's the same park.
